reserveReview.rationale: Existing composition remains the block 26107707 accounting observation: backing $5150523.219270193949, deployed principal $5013731.736653193831, USDC custody $136791.482617 and USDfr supply 5142565.55847783. Weights use backing value, not token supply or contractual face. Separately, at block 26114921 (2026-10-03T22:51:59Z), ClaimBridge totalOriginated=11 and every facility(1..11) is Active; all are nonrenewable. Maximum contractual maturity is 2029-05-29T00:00:00Z, giving a conservatively rounded-up remaining maximum of 969 days. This is a complete contractual maturity ceiling for the observed current facilities, not WAM, expected recovery timing, independent credit valuation or a permanent limit on future originations.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned Ethereum ReserveManager totalBackingValue/deployedPrincipal and canonical USDC balance at block 26107707
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Deployed credit book has onchain accounting and facility identifiers, but borrower identities, executed liens/segregation instruments, independently confirmed collateral and financial assurance remain unavailable. Idle USDC alone creates the tracked collateral dependency. The October 9 liquidity review found no whole-credit-book realization deadline: issuer operating limits bound direct USDfr redemption by idle USDC, while principal and PIK accrual enter NAV before cash arrives. The sUSDfr queue's 21-day minimum is a separate holder route, not a maximum liquidity horizon for this credit-book exposure; the timestamped research classification preserves that distinction.

Credit collateral is described as assigned, lien-perfected and escrowed via attester facts, but executed deeds, escrow account holders, borrower identities and asset-wide legal safeguards are not public. Named onchain custody cannot establish a whole-book regulated institutional tier.
